class.name: ListSettingsServer
class.brief_description: A [SettingsServer] whose settings are a list of entries, such as audio buses, input map actions or voices.

method.name: _get_entry_key
method.description: Returns the name of the property of an entry that identifies it in [method find_entry], for example [code]&"bus_name"[/code]. The default is an empty [StringName]: entries can only be found by index.

method.name: _get_list_property
method.description: Returns the name of the [Array] property of the settings resource that holds the entries. If it returns an empty [StringName] (the default), the first [Array] property of the settings resource is used.

method.name: _validate_entry_value
method.description: Returns the valid form of [param value] for the property [param name] of the entry at [param index], like [method SettingsServer._validate_value] does for single values. Called by [method set_entry_value] and for every entry value read by [method SettingsServer.load], after [param value] was checked against the range and enum hints of the entry's property. The default returns [param value] unchanged.

method.name: add_entry
method.description: Inserts [param entry] at [param at_index]. If [param at_index] is negative or not smaller than the size of the list, the entry is added to the end. Reports an error if [param entry] is [code]null[/code]. The [float] values of [param entry] are snapped to three decimals first (see [method SettingsServer.snap_float]). Emits [signal SettingsServer.value_changed].

method.name: clear_entries
method.description: Removes all entries. Does nothing if the list is empty.

method.name: find_entry
method.description: Returns the index of the first entry whose key property (see [method get_entry_key]) is equal to [param key], or [code]-1[/code] if there is none. Reports an error and returns [code]-1[/code] if the domain has no entry key.

method.name: get_entries
method.description: Returns a copy of the list of entries. Changing the returned array does not change the settings; the entries in it are the same objects as in the settings.

method.name: get_entry
method.description: Returns the entry at [param index]. Reports an error and returns [code]null[/code] if [param index] is out of range. Changes to the returned entry are not noticed by the server; use [method set_entry_value] instead.

method.name: get_entry_count
method.description: Returns the number of entries in the pending list.

method.name: get_entry_key
method.description: Returns the name of the property that identifies an entry, from [method _get_entry_key]. Empty by default.

method.name: get_entry_value
method.description: Returns the value of the property [param name] of the entry at [param index]. A [float] is returned snapped to the step of its range hint ([code]0.2[/code], not [code]0.20000000298023224[/code] for a 32-bit member). Reports an error and returns [code]null[/code] if [param index] is out of range.

method.name: get_list_property
method.description: Returns the name of the [Array] property of the settings resource that holds the entries, from [method _get_list_property]. By default this is the first [Array] property of the settings resource.

method.name: move_entry
method.description: Moves the entry at index [param from] to index [param to]. Reports an error if an index is out of range. Does nothing if both are equal.

method.name: remove_entry
method.description: Removes the entry at [param index]. Reports an error if [param index] is out of range.

method.name: set_entry_value
method.description: Sets the property [param name] of the entry at [param index]. The value is validated like a single value: a [float] is snapped to the step of its range hint or to [code]0.001[/code] (see [method SettingsServer.snap_float]), a number is clamped to the range hint of the entry's property ([constant PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE]), a value that is not one of its enum values ([constant PROPERTY_HINT_ENUM]) is rejected with an error and the current value is kept, then [method _validate_entry_value] is called and a [float] it returns is snapped again. Does nothing if the valid value does not change. Reports an error if [param index] is out of range or the entry has no such property. Emits [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] for the list property. Entry values in a hand-edited settings file are validated the same way when it is loaded.
